sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of High-Power DC Ultra-Fast Electric Vehicle Chargers

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-People's Republic of China Bilateral Investment Treaty (signed 30 May 1984, entered into force 29 April 1985)
France-People's Republic of China Double Taxation Agreement (signed 1984, as amended by the 2013 Amending Protocol, applicable from the 2015 tax year)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L.561-1 to L.561-50 and R.561-1 et seq.; Directive (EU) 2015/849 as amended by Directive (EU) 2018/843 (AMLD5); Law No. 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016 (Sapin II); PACTE Law No. 2019-486 of 22 May 2019 (mandatory UBO register); Decree No. 2017-1284 on the register of beneficial owners; Articles L.561-45 et seq. and R.561-55 et seq. of the Monetary and Financial Code (UBO declaration to the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés filed through the Guichet Unique and processed by INPI).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the corporate shareholder's business license (official PRC standardized business license certificate)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), People's Republic of China
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs or an authorized provincial Foreign Affairs Office; France-PRC Apostille relations operative since 7 November 2023, consular legalization no longer required

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the corporate shareholder, including confirmation of active registration and tax filing record
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and competent PRC tax administration
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs or an authorized provincial Foreign Affairs Office

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the memorandum and articles of association of the corporate shareholder, with certified company seal
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: PRC notarial certificate together with Hague Apostille by the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Corporate resolution and Power of Attorney appointing the representative and manager of the future French SARL
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Shareholders' meeting of the corporate shareholder, notarized by a PRC notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs or an authorized provincial Foreign Affairs Office

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce): Title III of Book II, Articles L. 223-1 to L. 223-43 (SARL), General company provisions at Articles L. 210-1 to L. 210-10; Decrees Nos. 2007-431 (23 March 2007) and 67-236 (23 March 1967); Order of 2 Feb 1998 (ICPE) not applicable to corporate formation.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Clerk of the Commercial Court) of the department of the registered office; receives and rules on the registration (immatriculation) of the company in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the INPI Guichet Unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Dossier d'immatriculation au Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), comprising the executed Articles of Association (statuts), the funds-deposit certificate, the registered-office justification, and the mandatory electronic declaration transmitted through the INPI Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (Formalité M0).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum share capital for SARL (Article L. 223-1, Code de commerce); the capital is fixed freely in the Articles of Association (at least EUR 1 and in divisible units). For cash contributions (apports en numéraire), at least 20% of the nominal amount must be paid up at subscription (Article L. 223-7, Code de commerce), and the remaining 80% must be paid within 5 years. Funds must be deposited in a blocked escrow bank account (compte bloqué) in the name of the company being formed, or deposited with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations; the depositary issues a certificat du dépositaire which must be produced for registration, and the funds cannot be released until the company is registered (Article L. 223-10).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST CORPORATE RESOLUTION OF THE INCORPORATING PARTNERS OF [SARL]. The undersigned partners resolve, pursuant to Articles L.223-1 et seq. of the French Commercial Code: (1) to adopt the Articles of Association; (2) to subscribe the share capital of EUR [amount] in [number] equal par-value shares and deposit cash contributions in a blocked escrow account; (3) to ratify the registered office at [address]; (4) to appoint [name] as sole Manager (gérant) with full powers to incorporate, operate and represent the company; and (5) to authorise the Manager to file the incorporation dossier with the INPI Guichet Unique, register with the RCS, publish the legal notice, and complete all ancillary formalities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of the Articles of Association and corporate-name reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: All incorporators (private act under Article R. 223-1) or a Notary (Notaire) if real estate is contributed; name reserved online via INPI data (attestation de réservation de nom).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Check the availability of the proposed name on the RCS/INPI databank and reserve it for 4 weeks. Draft the statuts (model statutes of the INPI/CNCE accepted) specifying the corporate form (SARL), duration (max 99 years), object (manufacture of high-power DC ultra-fast EV chargers - ISIC 2930), share capital and division by shares, manager (gérant) terms, registered office, and dispute provisions. Have all partners (minimum 2, maximum 100; single-member is EURL) sign each page. If a partner or manager is a non-EU foreign national, provide a French criminal-record equivalent or a sworn statement. Notarial signature (acte authentique) is required only for contributions of real estate or usufruct.
required_dossiers: Draft and signed Articles of Association (statuts)
Name-reservation attestation (certificat de réservation de nom) (optional)
Certified copy of identity document of each partner and manager
Proof of address (less than 3 months) of each partner and manager
Criminal-record certificate or equivalent for foreign nationals
Certificate of matrimonial regime / non-registration on the marriages register, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is unavailable or rejected, select a new distinctive sign and submit a new reservation within the INPI portal. If the prefecture/INPI queries the identity of a foreign manager, obtain an apostilled extract of the criminal record or a notarial certificate within 15 days; the signature of the statutory instrument may be re-executed accordingly.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of paid-up share capital in a blocked escrow account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French licensed credit institution or Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations (CDC) holding the compte bloqué.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a provisional bank account in the name of the company under formation. Wire the cash contributions from each partner's bank account, listing the depositor(s) and the share allocation. The bank issues an attestation de dépôt des fonds (deposit certificate) stating the amount deposited, the depositor, the name of the company being formed, and the date. The funds remain blocked until RCS registration or until the manager is formally appointed and executes; the manager may then use the funds only after the company is registered and with respect to the stated uses.
required_dossiers: Provisional company name and drafts of statuts
Identity documents and power of attorney of the depositing partner(s)
Proof of the source of funds / SWIFT credit advice
Bank account opening forms and KYC/AML questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank delays or queries the transfer under AML rules, provide the source-of-funds evidence (sale deed, dividend notices) or, failing that, deposit the funds with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations. The deposit certificate must be re-issued in case of change of capital amount or partners before registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the legal notice (avis de constitution) in the legal announcements gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorized legal announcements journal (Journal d'Annonces Légales - JAL) in the department of the registered office; electronic ALPE service of the approved publishers.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the notice containing the corporate name, form, capital, registered office, corporate object, duration, manager appointment, and identity of partners. Send the notice to an approved JAL and obtain a certificate of publication (attestation de parution/ALPE certificate). Since 2023 the publication number is notified to the Guichet Unique. The notice is not a precondition for filing but the certificate must be produced at the latest when registration is requested.
required_dossiers: Text of the avis de constitution (legal notice)
Order form and publication fee payment receipt
Copy of the statuts (for the gazette's control)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publisher fails to publish within two working days, request accelerated ALPE delivery or switch to another approved JAL with same-day service. The legal notice must contain no misleading statement; typographical errors are corrected by publishing a rectificatif and re-registering the APL certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the incorporation dossier through the INPI Guichet Unique (online RCS application)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) - Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises, portal: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the Guichet Unique and start the 'Création d'une société commerciale' formalities. Complete the electronic M0 declaration, upload the signed statuts, the deposit certificate, the registered-office justification, the manager's identity and powers, the criminal record, and pay the RCS fee (State tax) online. The INPI verifies the file, transmits it to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce. The Greffe verifies the legality of the statuts, the discharge of the legal publication, and issues the RCS registration. The company becomes a legal person upon registration and obtains the SIREN/SIRET numbers transmitted by INSEE.
required_dossiers: Signed Articles of Association (PDF)
Attestation de dépôt des fonds (deposit certificate)
Justification of the registered office (lease, domiciliation contract, or ownership title)
Attestation de parution of the legal notice
Identity documents and pouvoir (power of attorney) of the representative filing the dossier
Attestation de réservation de nom (cosmetic) (optional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the INPI portal returns a 'dossier incomplet' notice, the filer has 15 days to supplement online after the notice is issued; otherwise the request is rejected without prejudice. If the Greffe refuses registration (e.g., irregular corporate object, non-compliant statuts), the decision can be challenged within 10 days before the juge commis à la surveillance du registre (registry supervision judge).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS registration, issuance of the Kbis extract and national identifiers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office's department; INSEE (national statistics institute) for identification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After RCS registration: obtain the Kbis extract (official corporate identity document of the company), SIREN number, SIRET establishments, and the APE (Main Activity Code). The Kbis is the only legally valid proof of incorporation for procurement, financing, and customs purposes. The Greffe automatically publishes a notice in the BODACC. Verify the APE code: if registered as 2930Z (as expected under NAF 2025) or 2711Z (as per some classifications); if the APE code is wrong, file a modification through the Guichet Unique. Note that the assignation of an APE code by INSEE is not decisive for tax purposes but should reflect the main activity.
required_dossiers: Registration reference (numéro de dossier INPI) and payment receipts
Kbis extract request (issued automatically by the Greffe)
Copy of the signed statuts (already filed)
Proof of legal publication in ALPE (already filed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis is delayed or defective, contact the Greffe file officer; only the Greffe can correct a Kbis. If the APE code is incorrect, file a modification through the Guichet Unique or a direct correction request with the local INSEE/INPI centre (Sirene).

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration tax, social and cross-border clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE), URSSAF, Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), and Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 days after registration: (i) ensure the SARL has been referenced in the SIE tax office of the registered office; (ii) if the company has a material non-French shareholder, file the declaration of beneficial owners (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) with the Greffe/INPI within 15 days of registration; (iii) if the company will hire employees, register as an employer with URSSAF (before the first hire) and the médecine du travail; (iv) if the company will import components or export chargers, obtain an EORI number (DGDDI) and, for customs procedures, set up the customs economic operator (OEA) only if volume warrants; (v) open a business bank account in the company's name and, for VAT purposes, check the assignment of a French VAT number (néant for new SARL under the French VAT identification process - VAT number issued after registration upon request or automatically after the Chorus Pro account is opened).
required_dossiers: Kbis extract and SIREN/SIRET notification
Beneficial-owner declaration (Déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs) with identity documents
URSSAF employer-déclaration forms (DSN) and employee documents
DGDDI EORI application (form 4704-SD or online)
Company bank account opening file (ID, Kbis, proof of address)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SIE does not open the tax file, present the Kbis and the statuts to the local tax office to obtain the IS corporate-tax file number. Late declaration of beneficial owners triggers a EUR 1,000 per person fine (L. 561-6 Code monétaire et financier); file a voluntary corrective declaration (régularisation) immediately. EORI applications queried by the DGDDI can be re-submitted with an English translation of the Kbis.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) - Inspection des Installations Classées; Préfet du département; Mairie (urban planning) for site approval.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Récépissé de déclaration ICPE (Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement) - or Autorisation d'exploiter ICPE if the battery-storage threshold is exceeded; plus production/CE-marking conformity file (Déclaration de conformité UE) for the DC fast chargers under directives 2014/30/EU, 2014/35/EU, 2014/53/EU (if radio) and 2006/42/EC (if applicable).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: MRAe (Mission Régionale d'Autorité Environnementale) of the Conseil Général de l'Environnement et du Développement Durable (CGEDD), under the Préfet; technical inquiry by DREAL - Inspection des Installations Classées.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE regime: 'Déclaration' (D) for a light-assembly and final-testing plant under Rubrique 4331 (lithium-ion battery cells/packs storage > 100 kg per contiguous zone) or Rubrique 2935 (lead-acid battery storage) - typical for an EV charger factory holding stock. 'Enregistrement' (E) applies if discharge/energy thresholds are exceeded; full EIA report (Étude d'impact) is not required for the D/E regime, but the operator must submit a case-by-case 'examen au cas par cas' and an impact note where the site is included in the Annex to Article R.122-2 of the Environment Code (e.g., facilities subject to E regime are eo ipso subject to a simplified impact check).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater (ministerial order of 2 Feb 1998 for ICPE discharges): pH 5.5-8.5, TSS ≤ 35 mg/L, COD ≤ 125 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L, total chromium ≤ 0.1 mg/L, chromium VI < 0.1 mg/L, copper ≤ 0.5 mg/L, zinc ≤ 2 mg/L, nickel ≤ 0.5 mg/L; if connected to a municipal sewer, pre-authorization by the municipality and compliance with local sanitation by-laws is mandatory. Air: conformity with Decree No. 2019-944 (transposition of the IED 2010/75/EU industrial emissions) for any solvent or solder-flux use; VOC emissions < 10 mgC/m3 non-methane total, with regular smoke-stack testing. Waste: electronic waste and lithium batteries are tracked under the national EELEM/REP regimes; hazardous-waste register (registre des déchets) and mandatory national waste declaration; equipment placed on the EU market must respect RoHS (2011/65/EU) and REACH (1907/2006) substance limits (e.g., lead ≤ 0.1% in homogeneous materials).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) of the Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique; taxpayer portal impots.gouv.fr with the professional space 'Espace Professionnel'; business creation and VAT registration filed through the Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); export and customs clearance administered separately by the Direction Générale des Douanes et Droits Indirects (DGDDI) via the DELTA-X system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign parent forms the SARL through the Guichet Unique; DGFiP delivers SIREN, SIRET, and the intra-Community VAT number (format FR followed by the 11-digit SIREN and a two-digit control key) at incorporation. A non-established EU/EEA company supplying goods or services in France must complete the non-resident VAT registration procedure using Form Cerfa n° 14373 (Demande d'immatriculation TVA) and obtains a French FR-VAT number before making any taxable supply. A third-country (non-EU) entity without an EU establishment is subject to the 'service des impôts des non-résidents' procedure and must appoint a DGFiP-approved fiscal representative (représentant fiscal) for VAT unless a mutual administrative assistance treaty grants a dispensation. The export entity must separately obtain an EORI number (format FR + SIREN) through the DGDDI electronic registration portal before lodging export declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists in France; classification follows the legal form in the Code Général des Impôts. The SARL may, however, elect: (i) income-tax passthrough treatment as a 'SARL de famille' under CGI Art. 239bis AA where all partners are natural persons within the same family, binding for five years; (ii) inclusion in a VAT group ('assujetti unique') under CGI Art. 256C where close financial, economic, and organisational links exist with the group head; (iii) inclusion in a fiscal-integration group under CGI Art. 223A if a French parent holds at least 95% of the SARL's capital and voting rights, with a five-year commitment; (iv) the statutory reduced corporate income tax rate of 15% on the first EUR 42,500 of profit under CGI Art. 219 for SMEs meeting the EUR 10 million turnover and ownership conditions, which is a rate abatement rather than a free election. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available; French ATAD transposition (CGI Arts. 212bis and 209B) applies mandatorily.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) - Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA) - governed by EU Directive 2006/112/EC and CGI Arts. 256 to 262-0 bis; sales of DC fast-charger hardware are taxable at the standard VAT rate and are not subject to French energy-specific taxes (TICFE, TURPE) unless the SARL also acts as a charging-service operator selling electricity.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EUR 0 - French-established taxable persons must register from the first taxable transaction, with no domestic de minimis threshold. Non-established EU suppliers benefit from the harmonised intra-EU distance-sales threshold of EUR 10,000 annual EU-wide turnover (OSS special scheme), above which French VAT registration and French VAT apply; low-value import consignments not exceeding EUR 150 per shipment may be cleared under the Import One-Stop Shop (IOSS) without full French VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory structured electronic invoicing for domestic B2B transactions is phased in under Ordonnance n° 2024-609: all VAT-registered businesses must accept e-invoices from 1 September 2026; issuance becomes mandatory for large and mid-size enterprises from 1 September 2026 and for small/micro enterprises from 1 September 2027. Invoices must comply with the European standard EN 16931 (Factur-X hybrid, UBL, or CII formats) and must be transmitted to the recipient through a certified Dematerialisation Partner Platform (Plateforme de Dématérialisation Partenaire - PDP) or the public portal (Portail Public de Facturation - PPF), using the PDP's REST API; transaction e-reporting of B2B and B2C data to DGFiP is simultaneous. France does not operate real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping for manufactured goods; separate customs e-clearance applies via DELTA-X for export declarations and via DES declarations for intra-EU dispatches.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of manufactured DC fast-charger hardware outside the European Union qualify for the zero-rated export exemption under CGI Art. 262-I-1° where: (i) the transfer of the power of disposal in the goods is made to a purchaser not established in France or the EU; (ii) the goods are physically dispatched or transported out of EU territory by the seller, the purchaser, or a third party acting for either; (iii) the export declaration is lodged with DGDDI through DELTA-X and accepted before the end of the third calendar month following the transfer of ownership (BOFiP-TVA-EXP); and (iv) the French supplier retains full documentary proof (export declaration, transport evidence, commercial invoice, and payment evidence) for the statutory retention period. Intra-EU dispatches of chargers to a VAT-registered customer in another Member State also qualify for 0% under CGI Art. 262ter where the customer's intra-Community VAT number is valid and the transaction is reported in the DES/Intrastat framework.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export customs declaration (Déclaration d'Accompagnement Unique - DAU) lodged and validated through DELTA-X, evidencing physical exit from the EU
Transport document (Bill of Lading, multimodal CMR, or Air Waybill) proving removal of the goods from EU territory
Commercial invoice with Incoterms showing delivery to the third-country purchaser and transfer of power of disposal
Proof of payment / inward remittance certificate (SWIFT MT103 or bank credit advice) confirming repatriation of export proceeds to the French SARL
Consignee delivery receipt or customs-stamped landing certificate in cases where DGFiP requests supplementary evidence for high-value units
EORI registration confirmation and, where preferential tariff treatment is claimed, certificate of origin or EUR.1 movement certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating claims are a priority audit target of DGFiP's cross-border control division. Missing, contradictory, or forged export evidence triggers retrospective reassessment of VAT at the 20% standard rate on the export proceeds, plus statutory late-payment interest (intérêt de retard) and graduated civil penalties: 40% for deliberate inaccuracy or bad faith (mauvaise foi), 80% for fraudulent manoeuvres or abuse of law (manœuvres frauduleuses / abus de droit), and up to 100% for concealed business activity. The clawback/limitation period generally runs to the end of the third calendar year following the year the VAT became exigible, extended to six years for undisclosed activities, and further extended where foreign-based evasion or asset concealment is established; export evidence must be preserved for six years. Criminal exposure includes tax fraud under CGI Art. 1741 (up to EUR 500,000 fine and five years' imprisonment) and customs evasion under Code des Douanes Art. 414 (up to EUR 750,000 and seven years' imprisonment), with DGFiP able to publish the sanctions and to set off any refund against the reassessed liability.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, with foreign-exchange policy oversight delegated from the French Treasury (Direction Générale du Trésor) under the Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté Industrielle et Numérique
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: EUR is fully convertible under the eurozone framework, OECD codes, and EU Treaty free-movement-of-capital rules. France maintains full current-account and capital-account liberalisation for EU and third-country counterparties, with no prior authorisation for capital injection or profit remittance. Dividends and other distributions may be freely remitted to non-resident shareholders subject to standard KYC/AML documentation, a compliance check under the Monetary and Financial Code, and statistical balance-of-payments reporting by the bank. Practical hurdles are limited to correspondent-bank sanctions screening and enhanced due diligence on non-EU payment chains; no legal convertibility restriction applies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no mandatory export-proceeds surrender ratio and no statutory repatriation deadline for sales receipts. Exporters of DC fast-charging equipment may retain 100% of foreign-currency revenue and are not obligated to convert into EUR. However, all cross-border transactions must be declared to the Banque de France for balance-of-payments statistical purposes via the resident bank; transactions may be subject to monthly or quarterly reporting thresholds under the 'EEC – États récapitulatifs des échanges' regime, and non-compliance carries administrative penalty risk.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Commercial Operating Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium under strict conditions. An offshore digital EMI domiciled outside the EEA has Low viability as a primary treasury rail because the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) requires banking and e-money services to be provided by licensed credit institutions or ACPR-registered electronic-money institutions; a non-EEA EMI cannot obtain a French license and cannot legally open a settlement or liquidity account in the name of the SARL. An EU/EEA-licensed EMI, however, can passport into France under PSD2 and may be used for disbursements, but it cannot act as a substitute for a French bank account for capital escrow, documentary credits, or balance-of-payments reporting obligations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is permitted under ACPR anti-money-laundering rules and CNIL-validated video-identification procedures, but for a non-resident-owned SARL most Tier-1 French banks require a physical interview with the legal representative ('gérant') or a notarised and apostilled board resolution authorising the opening. Bank practice varies: some banks allow a fully remote interview with Advanced Electronic Signatures and certified passport copies, while others mandate an in-person visit to the branch for the capital-escrow account. For non-resident shareholders, a certified copy of the corporate constitutional documentation (Statuts), Kbis extract, and UBO declaration are normally mandatory.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident beneficial owner with an indirect non-EU shareholding chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised corporate ownership chart, French Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) filing, bank reference letter from the shareholder's overseas bank, sanction-list screening report demonstrating no SDN match, and statutory financial statements or source-of-funds statement authenticated by a reputable CPA.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of the cross-border capital injection for acquisition of EV charging hardware.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully signed executed share-purchase agreement, invoice and transport/customs documentation supporting the HK/global hardware purchase, board resolution approving the transfer, SARL Kbis extract and Statuts, and a detailed cash-flow business plan in French or English proving the intended zero-evasion purpose.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Recommended rail: SWIFT MT103 for direct EUR credit transfer from the non-resident shareholder, or SWIFT MT202 COVER when settlement via an intermediary is required. The beneficiary field must include the SARL legal name, IBAN (France), and BIC of the French bank account. The instruction must carry the purpose code for direct investment into French corporate equity, and the French bank will report it as 'Augmentation de capital – investissement direct' to the Banque de France. Supporting documents: certified Statuts, Kbis extract, UBO register, notarised share transfer minutes, and AML declaration of source of funds. No prior exchange-control approval is required.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For overseas trade settlement with component suppliers and logistics vendors, the primary clearing rails are: (1) SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers, (2) SWIFT MT700 in favour of a commercial documentary letter of credit under UCP 600 when the supplier requires secured payment, and (3) SWIFT MT202 for interbank cover. For guaranteed trade terms, a commercial LC is advisable for high-value DC fast-charger components; all payments are subject to standard sanction-screening and will be reported by the bank for French balance-of-payments statistics.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/foreign-currency deliverable forward for invoice-matched maturities
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) restricted to genuinely illiquid/restricted-currency exposures
FX swap (swap de change) for temporary liquidity repositioning
Cross-currency swap for matching long-term EUR and hard-currency debt/service streams

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Shareholder annual general meeting (AGO) approving the annual financial statements, management report and profit appropriation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General meeting of shareholders of the SARL (internal corporate record; decisions entered in the register of shareholder resolutions)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of the fiscal year-end; by 30 June for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the AGO and approve accounts within 6 months: court order available at the request of any shareholder; fine up to €15,000 for the gérant; dividend distributions and other appropriations prohibited until accounts are approved.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (déclaration de résultats IS / liasse fiscale: form 2065-SD with annexes 2050 to 2059)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP); mandatory electronic filing via impots.gouv.fr
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Second business day after 1 May following the fiscal year-end for calendar-year taxpayers; within 3 months of the fiscal year-end for off-calendar year-ends
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of the amount due, increased to 40% after formal notice in bad faith and 80% for fraudulent conduct; late-payment interest of 0.20% per month; ex-officio tax assessment risk.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax final balance payment (solde d'impôt sur les sociétés) reconcile with quarterly instalments (15 March, 15 June, 15 September, 15 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP / Public Treasury; payment by direct debit or electronic transfer
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 15th day of the 4th month following the fiscal year-end; 15 April for calendar-year taxpayers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-payment penalty of 5% plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.20%; enforced collection measures including third-party seizure (avis à tiers détenteur) and asset distraint after formal notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Filing of certified annual accounts (balance sheet, profit and loss account, notes) and annexed management report with the Commercial Court Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; electronic filing via the guichet unique (INPI portal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month of shareholder approval, and in all cases within 7 months of fiscal year-end; 31 July for a 31 December year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to €15,000 for legal representatives; injunctive proceedings brought by the Public Prosecutor; persistent non-filing for consecutive years may trigger administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS; publication restrictions and inability to obtain a certificate of good standing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual declaration and payment of the local business property contribution (Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises - CFE)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP local tax office (Service des Impôts des Entreprises) competent for the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Form 1447-C return due by 3 May of the tax year; final CFE payment due 15 December; instalments (October and November) apply where annual CFE exceeds €3,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late-return penalty, 5% late-payment penalty plus 0.20% monthly interest; loss of first-year exemption if declaration omitted; forced collection through tax lien and third-party seizure after formal notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Update of the declaration of beneficial owners (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs - RBE) annexed to a registry modification filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RBE central register operated with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership, in the statutory particulars of beneficial owners, or in the shareholding structure; no refiling required in a year without changes; annual internal review at each fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to €7,500 for individuals and €37,500 for legal entities for failure to file or false declaration; criminal sanctions for intentional omission; suspension of voting rights for shares whose beneficial owner is not declared.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Appointment of a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory when at least two of the three following thresholds are exceeded at fiscal year-end: total balance sheet €4,000,000; net turnover €8,000,000; average workforce 50 employees. The mandate also becomes compulsory for a SARL that heads a group, is controlled by an entity preparing consolidated accounts, or operates in specific regulated sectors.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général - PCG, pursuant to ANC Règlement 2014-03, as amended) is mandatory for the individual statutory accounts of the SARL; IFRS is permitted for consolidated accounts of qualifying groups only.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: French law does not impose a standalone annual UBO refiling; the RBE declaration is made at incorporation and must be updated with the Greffe within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership. The gérant is required to verify the RBE and the shareholding register at each fiscal year-end, and the annual AGO serves as the formal annual confirmation checkpoint; any share transfer affecting ultimate beneficial ownership must be declared through a registry modification act.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of share movements (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of corporate decisions and attendance sheets (registre des décisions d'associés / feuilles de présence)
Register of beneficial owners (registre des bénéficiaires effectifs - RBE)
Corporate minute book (procès-verbaux of shareholders' meetings)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$250 - US$650 per year for commercial domiciliation or registered agent services in France
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$6,000 - US$18,000 per year for a mandatory statutory audit (commissaire aux comptes) of a mid-sized industrial SARL; voluntary expert-comptable accounts review US$2,000 - US$5,000 per year if the audit-exempt regime applies

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: Standard French corporate income tax rate of 25% for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2022; small and medium enterprises with turnover below €10 million benefit from a 15% reduced rate on the first €42,500 of taxable profit.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No generic tax holiday; effective reliefs include the Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% of eligible R&D expenditure up to €100 million, the Innovation Tax Credit (CII) at 20% of eligible prototype development costs, the reduced 15% CIT rate for SMEs, and accelerated depreciation for industrial digital equipment and green energy technologies.
